Class Animation

java.lang.Object
dev.marasmium.kit.applib.assets.Animation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Animation extends Object implements Cloneable
Data structure representing an animation which can be applied to a sprite to be drawn by the MarasmiumKit application framework

      public boolean initialize(int targetFPS, Vector sheetDimensions, Vector frameDimensions, int frameCount, Colour[] data)
      Initialize this animation with a target FPS, sheet and frame dimensions, frame count, and pixel data
      Parameters:
      targetFPS - The target FPS to draw of this animation
      sheetDimensions - The dimensions of this animation's texture in frames
      frameDimensions - The dimensions of this animation's frame's in pixels
      frameCount - The number of frames to store in this animation
      data - The pixel colour data for this animation's texture

      Whether this animation was initialized successfully
